title: glycocalyx-egns: analysis code for endothelial glycocalyx non-resolution after myocardial infarction
description: Analysis scripts reproducing all module scores, statistical tests, spatial analyses, communication inference, perturbation analyses and figures of the manuscript. Two methods are documented re-implementations rather than official tool runs (network edge-ablation inspired by scTenifoldKnk; a CellOracle-inspired vector-field analysis that failed its own trajectory-validity check and is reported only as a negative result).
